title: fix: add overallTemperature to CoffeeProfile model
body:
## Summary

- The Fellow API now expects `overallTemperature` instead of `temperature` when creating/updating profiles
- Without this field in the `CoffeeProfile` Pydantic model, profile creation fails with a 400 error: `"property temperature should not exist"`
- Adds `overallTemperature` as a required field with the same validation range as other temperature fields (50–99°C in 0.5° steps)

## Reproduction

```python
from fellow_aiden import FellowAiden

aiden = FellowAiden(email, password)
aiden.create_profile({
    "profileType": 0,
    "title": "Test",
    "ratio": 16.5,
    "overallTemperature": 96,  # This field is required by the API
    "bloomEnabled": True,
    "bloomRatio": 3,
    "bloomDuration": 40,
    "bloomTemperature": 97,
    "ssPulsesEnabled": True,
    "ssPulsesNumber": 4,
    "ssPulsesInterval": 20,
    "ssPulseTemperatures": [96, 96, 95, 95],
    "batchPulsesEnabled": True,
    "batchPulsesNumber": 2,
    "batchPulsesInterval": 30,
    "batchPulseTemperatures": [95, 95],
})
# Before fix: 400 Bad Request — "property temperature should not exist"
# After fix: profile created successfully
```

## Test plan

- [x] Verified `create_profile` succeeds with `overallTemperature` against the live Fellow API
- [x] Confirmed existing profiles returned by the API include `overallTemperature` (not `temperature`)
